key_terms.نَصْرُ اللَّهِ: Divine help or assistance from God

ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of 'Nasr Allah' and 'Al-Fath' in Surah An-Nasr?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often viewed as the Prophet's farewell address, signaling the completion of the divine message and the impending transition of authority to the Ahl al-Bayt. The 'clear victory' (fathun mubeen) is interpreted not only as the conquest of Mecca but also as the ultimate triumph of truth and the establishment of the Imamate. This marks the culmination of prophetic efforts, linking the earthly success of Islam with its spiritual perfection.
